name: Trenches Mentality
tagline: Out the trenches, one honest skill at a time.
description: A community for people doing everything they can to make it out the trenches: through tech, AI, agriculture, the arts and any noble work.
author: Hopson

pillars.name: Tech
pillars.line: Learning to build, fix and sell with code and tools anyone can get.

pillars.name: AI
pillars.line: Using AI as a co-worker, not a magic trick. What actually pays.

pillars.name: Agriculture
pillars.line: Soil, seeds, livestock and the business side of feeding people.

pillars.name: Arts
pillars.line: Music, design, film, words. Turning talent into a living.

pillars.name: Hustle
pillars.line: Money, discipline, side income and the mindset that holds it together.
